cohort: original middle cached prefix per family, legal public bounds/AGL/obstacles; deterministic map-stratified hash; no target/error selection
library: hold, approach, left, right, descend, ascend toward each retained merged mode; each at nadir or 20/40/60 aimed at that mode; add recorded-yaw obliques
history: causal original cached ROI evidence plus reached credible rendered regions; no future frame selection
oracle: offline exact best legal two-exposure trace in evaluated catalogue: repeated first-step public library views plus six reached policy traces; upper bound only for this catalogue, NOT global physical optimum
frame_quality: unchanged P3-A gates; z-buffer measured points; radius1; 512 square/HFOV90
cost_reporting: movement m, vertical m, cloud/actual render seconds, gimbal rotation degrees, exposure count; no invented flight-time model
stop: Stage A fails => no frozen inference; fewer than50 visible-error families => identity acceptance unavailable; no fusion or closedloop
history_quality_prior: 0.5 + 0.5 * last reached frame valid fraction; positive prior avoids zero utility from initial empty view
